title: Hires per year
statementMd:
How many people were hired in each calendar year? Show year and count, oldest year first.

Expected columns: `year`, `hires`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y', hire_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS hires FROM employees GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
